sentences.text: This salmon shark was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Salmon sharks keep their bodies warmer than the surrounding water, which lets them hunt in cold northern seas.
Its track spans from {northernmost_lat} down to {southernmost_lat}, and on {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where it began.
Its daily positions add up to {path_km}.
